facts.text: Devaron was a terrestrial jungle planet located in the Devaron system of the galaxy's Colonies that was the homeworld of the Devaronian species.

evidence.quote: Devaron was a terrestrial jungle planet located in the Devaron system of the galaxy's Colonies that was the homeworld of the Devaronian species.

facts.text: The world was home to a Jedi Temple and was the site of a battle during the Clone Wars as well as skirmish during the Galactic Civil War.
entities: Skirmish in the Temple of Eedit

evidence.quote: The world was home to a Jedi Temple and was the site of a battle during the Clone Wars as well as skirmish during the Galactic Civil War.

facts.text: Numerous rivers and valleys dotted the mountainous landscape, while the planet's ecological balance was maintained by the natives for countless generations.

evidence.quote: Numerous rivers and valleys dotted the mountainous landscape, while the planet's ecological balance was maintained by the natives for countless generations.

facts.text: Sparsely populated areas were allowed to thrive in their natural state without urbanization or industrialization spreading beyond contained cities or settlements.

evidence.quote: Sparsely populated areas were allowed to thrive in their natural state without urbanization or industrialization spreading beyond contained cities or settlements.

facts.text: Male Devaronians were prone to wanderlust, explore the jungles of Devaron while the females of the species maintained and built cities and societies which could stand the test of time.

evidence.quote: Male Devaronians were prone to wanderlust, explore the jungles of Devaron while the females of the species maintained and built cities and societies which could stand the test of time.

facts.text: Wildlife valued the shelter provided by the vines, and the biosphere of Devaron was rich with animals and creatures of all shapes and sizes.

evidence.quote: Wildlife valued the shelter provided by the vines, and the biosphere of Devaron was rich with animals and creatures of all shapes and sizes.

facts.text: When the Galactic Empire came to power, the state of Devaron's environs was threatened.

evidence.quote: When the Galactic Empire came to power, the state of Devaron's environs was threatened.

facts.text: The reigning Imperial governor during the Galactic Civil War was known for going on extravagant wildlife hunts, as well as denying the natives the ability to grow their own food.

evidence.quote: The reigning Imperial governor during the Galactic Civil War was known for going on extravagant wildlife hunts, as well as denying the natives the ability to grow their own food.

facts.text: The history of Devaron was marked by its cultural division between the two genders of the Devaronian species; while males were struck with wanderlust, females sought to establish cities and grow the culture.

evidence.quote: The history of Devaron was marked by its cultural division between the two genders of the Devaronian species; while males were struck with wanderlust, females sought to establish cities and grow the culture.

facts.text: As wandering the jungles on hunting expeditions became a cultural rite of passage for males of the species, the Devaronian females began to industrialize, evolving over time into a spacefaring culture as early as thirty thousand years before the Battle of Yavin.

evidence.quote: As wandering the jungles on hunting expeditions became a cultural rite of passage for males of the species, the Devaronian females began to industrialize, evolving over time into a spacefaring culture as early as thirty thousand years before the Battle of Yavin.

facts.text: As the planet developed a planetary government, it became one of the earliest members of the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: As the planet developed a planetary government, it became one of the earliest members of the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: One of the outermost planets in the Republic for millennia, Devaronians served as hyperspace scouts and could easily find employment in the field of interstellar travel.

evidence.quote: One of the outermost planets in the Republic for millennia, Devaronians served as hyperspace scouts and could easily find employment in the field of interstellar travel.

facts.text: While the government of Devaron had established a fair and balanced democratic system that allowed males and females to pursue the lifestyle they saw best for themselves, most of Devaron's best and brightest leaders, politicians, and business elites were females.

evidence.quote: While the government of Devaron had established a fair and balanced democratic system that allowed males and females to pursue the lifestyle they saw best for themselves, most of Devaron's best and brightest leaders, politicians, and business elites were females.

facts.text: One of the earliest planetary governments to join the Galactic Republic, sometime between 25,000 BBY and 22,000 BBY, Devaron was one of the farthest points in known space, forming a border with Wild Space for millennia.

facts.text: While the government of Devaron was a representative government that matured to a point where the strict divisions between gender roles was blurred, Devaronian females were historically the most prestigious government officials.

evidence.quote: While the government of Devaron was a representative government that matured to a point where the strict divisions between gender roles was blurred, Devaronian females were historically the most prestigious government officials.

facts.text: To this end, the government was largely matriarchal, as males sought out roles that better suited their primal wanderlust that drove them into the jungles or the stars.
